messages:
Maya (Support): escalating — AcmeHealth reported a data residency/compliance alert during our maintenance window. They say requests for their org were routed to us-east-1 and triggered KMS/access exceptions.

Maya (Support): customer symptoms: 403s on decrypt, elevated latency (~600-800ms), and unexpected egress billing. They flagged audit log alerts from their side.

Maya (Support): attaching relevant lines from their correlation id and our routing logs:
```log
2026-03-17T09:57:12Z level=warn msg="fallback_region_used" customer=acme-health req_id=abc123 orig_region=eu-west-1 routed_region=us-east-1 policy=smart-fallback
2026-03-17T09:57:12Z level=error msg="kms_policy_violation" customer=acme-health req_id=abc123 kms_arn=arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:1111:key/abcd action=Decrypt result=AccessDenied
2026-03-17T09:57:13Z level=info msg="latency" customer=acme-health req_id=abc123 p50=620 p95=1100
```

Maya (Support): repro steps from customer (they provided):
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
     -H "X-RW-Region: eu-west-1" \
     -H "X-Correlation-ID: abc123" \
     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
```
They recorded headers showing routed_region=us-east-1 in upstream response headers.

Maya (Support): customer account: acme-health (tenant-2443). They have Dedicated capacity pinned to eu-west-1 and explicitly set data_residency=EU in console.

IncidentBot: created incident INC-2026-0452 (P0) — region-failover-data-residency — tags: dedicated, data-residency, compliance

Jonas (SRE): looking. Initial glance at routing logs shows a fallback event at 2026-03-17T09:57:12Z that routed requests to the nearest available pool (us-east-1) because eu-west-1 pool reported transient OOMs. That should not happen for dedicated tenants with residency=EU. :eyes:

Jonas (SRE): suspicion: routing layer evaluation skipped strict_affinity check for dedicated clusters during maintenance window. Pulling config and feature flags now.

Jonas (SRE): quick query:
```sql
SELECT * FROM routing_events WHERE tenant='tenant-2443' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-17T09:56:00Z' AND '2026-03-17T10:00:00Z';
```
returns event with fallback=true, reason=capacity, dest_region=us-east-1

Maya (Support): customer also attached a compliance alert: their org-level audit shows keys attempted to be used in us-east-1 -> KMS denied. Legal is now involved.

Sarah (Legal): on it. Need complete audit export (request headers, routing decisions, timestamps) and list of affected requests. This is potentially a data residency violation — classify accordingly. Please include all KMS AccessDenied events and policy ARN references. :rotating_light:

Jonas (SRE): mitigation plan timeline:
- immediate: rollback cross-region fallback for tenant-2443 (disable fallback flag on routing service) — done (09:58:40Z)
- immediate: add routing blocklist to prevent any enterprise/dedicated tenant from cross-region failover during maintenance — deploying now
- short term (10-30m): apply patch to routing eval to respect strict_affinity flag for dedicated clusters (hotfix PR #3491)
- monitor: audit logs and re-run customer repro

Jonas (SRE): hotfix details (config snippet):
```yaml
routing:
  policy: smart-fallback
  enterprise_strict_affinity: true   # enforce no cross-region fallback for dedicated/enterprise
```
PR is open and CI passing; canary to eu-west-1 in ~15m.

Ravi (AE): I've told AcmeHealth we've put a stop-gap in place and will absorb egress billing for the window. They're asking for exported audit logs and an ETA for root cause.

Maya (Support): repro steps for SRE/support to collect if needed:
1) use customer's token with X-RW-Region: eu-west-1 and X-Correlation-ID
2) hit /v1/chat and capture response headers (x-rw-routed-region, x-rw-req-id)
3) collect routing_event for req_id

Maya (Support): example curl to capture headers:
```bash
curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "X-RW-Region: eu-west-1" -H "X-Correlation-ID: test-rcp-1" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat
# look for: x-rw-routed-region, x-rw-req-id, x-rw-routing-reason
```

Sarah (Legal): also need confirmation that any persisted customer data was not copied to us-east-1. If KMS denied decrypt, likely no data moved, but we must verify storage locations of any temporary caches / logs.

Jonas (SRE): confirmed: KV cache misses alone wouldn't copy encrypted model context, but we need to audit our telemetry/ingest pipelines. Running grep on storage manifests now.

Jonas (SRE): found one telemetry record where routed_region was set to us-east-1 and forwarded to observability pipeline — queuing a retention/block purge for tenant-2443 logs from that pipeline. Patch queued.

OpsDeployBot: deployed routing blocklist for tenant-2443 to eu-west-1 cluster at 2026-03-17T09:58:40Z

Maya (Support): customer asked for a written timeline and ticket ID for their compliance team. Ravi will own external comms.

Ravi (AE): I'll send a timeline + promise of audit export by EOD and confirm waived egress fees. Including a short incident summary.

Sarah (Legal): request for data: export all request headers and routing events for tenant-2443 between 2026-03-17T09:55:00Z and 2026-03-17T10:05:00Z. Also include KMS AccessDenied events.

Jonas (SRE): export in progress. ETA ~25m. Also enabling extra retention on routing logs for legal review.

Maya (Support): marking this thread as P0 and linking to INC-2026-0452. Need postmortem after RCA.

Jonas (SRE): root cause (preliminary): routing-service feature flag logic mistakenly treated dedicated pools as fallthrough-eligible during transient capacity failures. Fix PR #3491 enforces enterprise_strict_affinity and adds unit + integration tests. Postmortem and follow-ups to include: stricter QA for routing flags, add e2e for dedicated tenant residency, alert on KMS AccessDenied spikes per tenant.

Maya (Support): thanks. I'll keep customer updated and attach exports when ready.

Sarah (Legal): noted. Will prepare compliance notification template and coordinate.

Ravi (AE): I'll follow up with compensation and ask for any additional logs the customer can provide.

Jonas (SRE): monitoring — no further fallback events for tenant-2443 after blocklist. Keeping watch for canary results. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: last update logged 2026-03-17T10:06:00Z — status: mitigated (blocklist applied), next: postmortem
